manual.title: This document has no readable text
manual.description: Scanned and image-only documents are not guessed. Enter the role manually or choose a text-based file.

resume.title: This brief is already in HireCall

retry.title: The import could not finish
retry.description: No role was created. Try the source again or continue manually.

unreachable.title: This job posting could not be read
unreachable.description: The site blocks automated reads and the posting is not in the public index. No role was created — paste a different link or enter the role manually.

review.title: Check the role brief
review.fileDescription: HireCall extracted the document without inventing missing fields. Confirm the details before questions are drafted.
